{{nihongo|'''Kamitakatsuki Shrine'''|神高槻神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in Takatsuki, Takatsuki-chō, {{ill|Nagahama, Shiga|Q844130|qid=Q844130}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} recorded in the '{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'. {{nihongo|'''Kamitakatsuki Shrine'''|神高槻神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

==Enshrined deities==
* {{ill|Ame-no-Koyane|Q2564508|qid=Q2564508|lt=Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Kazuraki no Takanukahime|ja|葛城高顙媛|ko|가즈라키노 다카누카히메|qid=Q21995144|lt=Takanuka-hime-no-Mikoto}}

==Shrine crest==
* Left-dancing Mitsu-gashiwa

==Shrine name==
There is a tradition that {{ill|Kasuga-no-Kami|fr|Kasuga no Kami|ja|春日神|simple|Kasuga-no-Kami|zh|春日神|qid=Q11088805}} descended upon a giant {{ill|Zelkova serrata|ar|زلكوفا منشارية|arz|زلكوفا منشاريه|az|Zelkova serrata|ceb|Zelkova serrata|cs|Zelkova pilovitá|da|Japansk zelkova|de|Japanische Zelkove|es|Zelkova serrata|eu|Japoniar zelkoba|fa|نارون ژاپنی|fi|Idänselkova|fr|Zelkova serrata|frr|Zelkova serrata|hu|Japán gyertyánszil|id|Terbas jepang|ja|ケヤキ|ko|느티나무|lt|Japoninis skirpstulas|nl|Japanse zelkova|no|Keaki|pl|Brzostownica japońska|pt|Zelkova serrata|pwn|tjeves|ru|Дзельква пильчатая|sco|Zelkova serrata|sv|Zelkova serrata|tr|Zelkova serrata|vi|Zelkova serrata|war|Zelkova serrata|zh|榉树|zh_yue|櫸樹|qid=Q920344|lt=tsuki tree}} at Kurihara, Aza Unenogahara (Une, Takatsuki-chō), and a shrine was built in the {{ill|Tenpyō|Q1199879|qid=Q1199879}} era (729-749) to worship Ame-no-Koyane-no-Mikoto.<br />
Later, a shrine building enshrining Takanuka-hime-no-Mikoto together was said to have been founded by {{ill|Heguri Clan|ja|平群氏|qid=Q11483498|lt=Heguri Hirowaza}}.<br />
In the {{ill|Kanji (era)|fa|کانجی (دوره)|fr|Ère Kanji|ia|Kanji (era)|id|Kanji (nama zaman)|ja|寛治|ko|간지 (연호)|ru|Кандзи (нэнго)|simple|Kanji (era)|sr|Канџи (ера)|tr|Kanji (dönem)|zh|寬治|zh_yue|寬治|qid=Q1193874}} era (1087-1094), when {{ill|Ōe no Masafusa|de|Ōe no Masafusa|es|Ōe no Masafusa|fr|Ōe no Masafusa|it|Ōe no Masafusa|ja|大江匡房|ko|오에노 마사후사|sh|Ōe no Masafusa|uk|Ое но Масафуса|zh|大江匡房|qid=Q3135978}} visited this area and praised the moon with a waka, it is said "Takatsuki" was later changed to "Takatsuki (高月)."<br />
It was the {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=sōsha}} of seven villages - Une, Ahe, Takatsuki, Morimoto, Ochikawa, Mōjō, and Doganji (roughly the former {{ill|Minamitominaga|ja|南富永村|ko|미나미토미나가촌|qid=Q17175516}} area).<br />
In {{ill|Meiji era|ar|فترة مييجي|ast|Dómina Meiji|az|Meydzi dövrü|azb|مئی‌جی دؤورو|be|Перыяд Мэйдзі|bn|মেইজি যুগ|bo|མེའི་ཇིའི་དུས་དུས་མཚམས།|ca|Era Meiji|cs|Období Meidži|da|Meiji-perioden|de|Meiji-Zeit|el|Μεϊτζί (περίοδος)|es|Era Meiji|et|Meiji periood|eu|Meiji Aroa|fa|دوره میجی|fi|Meiji-kausi|fr|Ère Meiji|gl|Período Meiji|he|תקופת מייג'י|hr|Meiji (razdoblje)|ht|Epòk Meiji|hu|Meidzsi-kor|id|Zaman Meiji|io|Ero Meiji|is|Meiji-tímabilið|it|Periodo Meiji|ja|明治|ka|მეიძის ეპოქა|kbp|Mejii wɛɛ yaa alɩwaatʊ|kk|Мэйдзи дәуірі|ko|메이지 시대|la|Aetas Meiji|lt|Meidži laikotarpis|lv|Meidzi periods|mk|Меиџи (период)|mn|Мэйжийн эрин|ms|Zaman Meiji|nl|Meijiperiode|nn|Meiji|no|Meiji-perioden|pl|Meiji (okres)|pt|Era Meiji|ro|Perioada Meiji|ru|Мэйдзи|simple|Meiji period|sk|Obdobie Meidži|sq|Periudha Meixhi|sr|Меиџи период|sv|Meijiperioden|ta|மெய்சி காலம்|th|ยุคเมจิ|tl|Panahong Meiji|tr|Meiji Dönemi|uk|Період Мейдзі|ur|میجی دور|vi|Thời kỳ Minh Trị|war|Panahon Meiji|wuu|明治|zh|明治|zh_classical|明治|zh_min_nan|Bêng-tī|zh_yue|明治|qid=Q3125096}} 9 ({{ill|1876|Q7766|qid=Q7766}}), it was ranked {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}.<ref>[https://www.shiga-jinjacho.jp/ycBBS/Board.cgi/02_jinja_db/db/ycDB_02jinja-pc-detail.html?mode:view=1&view:oid=1219 Shiga Prefectural Shrine Association]</ref>

Until {{ill|Shinbutsu bunri|ca|Shinbutsu bunri|de|Shinbutsu-Bunri|es|Shinbutsu bunri|fa|شینبوتسو بونری|fi|Shinbutsu bunri|fr|Shinbutsu bunri|id|Shinbutsu bunri|it|Shinbutsu bunri|ja|神仏分離|ru|Симбуцу бунри|tr|Şinbutsu-bunri|zh|神佛分離|qid=Q1970535}}, neighboring {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Daien-ji}} served as its {{ill|Bettō-ji|ja|別当寺|qid=Q11396755}} temple.
